work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Letter CCXLII to Bishop Louis-François of Bayeux condemns the new society claiming a lay apostolate, a “third reign” of the Holy Spirit and visions, linked to the self-styled Duke of Normandy, and approves the bishop’s measures; address LF42253–42255, intitulation, greeting, body, blessing and dating clause survive. Issuer evidence: GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF42258–42258; the source dating clause at LF42373–42376 reads: Datum Romae apud s. Petrum die octava novembris millesimo octingentesimo quadrage- simo tertio, pontificatus Nostri anno decimo tertio. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
